No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. The actor remains within a separately resized stage header, two side curtain bands and a shared floor. The source tunic, extended hand, lowered hand, head/neck, two exposed legs and two shoes remain. The figure contours are independently rebuilt at 58% source coordinate dimensions with original 1.4 mm strokes; the stage is narrowed independently instead of shrinking the person with it. The lowered hand and forearm are moved 2 mm outward, with the left curtain moved outward to preserve clearance. Shoes keep their actual floor contacts. The theatrical setting plus external role key supplies context; generic clothing or gesture alone does not identify an actor.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "The actor remains within a separately resized stage header, two side curtain bands and a shared floor. The lowered hand and forearm are moved 2 mm outward, with the left curtain moved outward to preserve clearance. Shoes keep their actual floor contacts.
